text: {"lessons":["My account has lost value overall, despite small gains in the last few periods, so I should keep my retirement needs and tolerance for large losses central to decisions.","Selling the same number of shares in every stock realized losses in several holdings; I should make deliberate, risk-based decisions rather than react to losses or treat every holding alike.","I should avoid frequent or impulsive trading, and review whether my holdings are diversified and whether keeping some cash would better support stability and living expenses."]}
